Roast tomato soup, a cheddar toastie to dip.How to make it1.2kg ripe tomatoes, halved1 brown onion, quartered4 garlic cloves3 tbsp olive oil500ml vegetable stock1 tsp brown sugar100ml thickened cream8 slices of white sandwich bread160g vintage cheddar, grated40g soft butterToss the tomatoes, onion and garlic with the oil and salt and roast at 200°C until soft and blistered.Blend with the stock and sugar, then simmer, stir in the cream and season.Fill the bread with cheddar, butter the outsides and toast in a pan until golden and melting.Cut the toasties into fingers and serve with the soup, for parting or dunking.Stanley Cup Buffalo wingsBruce makes the Sabres win the Cup. Hot sauce wings, blue cheese dip, celery.How to make it1.2kg chicken wings, tips off, split1 tbsp baking powder125ml Frank's RedHot sauce60g butter100g blue cheese, crumbled125g sour cream2 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 lemon4 celery sticks, cut in batonsPat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and a teaspoon of salt.Bake on a rack at 220°C, turning once, until crisp and golden.Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream, mayo and a squeeze of lemon.Melt the butter into the hot sauce and toss the wings through it.A jar of dill pickles on the counterFree with every miracle.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Blue PlatesEvan's prime rib roast with horseradish creamThe Prime rib roast Minister, says Evan. Slow-roast rib of beef, jus, mash, greens.How to make it2kg standing beef rib roast, 2 bones2 tbsp olive oil1 tbsp cracked black pepper4 garlic cloves, crushed250ml beef stock1kg floury potatoes80g butter150ml milk300g green beans150ml sour cream2 tbsp grated horseradishRub the beef with the oil, garlic, pepper and plenty of salt and bring to room temperature.Roast at 230°C for 15 minutes, then at 160°C until it reads 54°C inside for medium rare.Rest the beef under foil while you make the jus from the pan juices and stock.Meanwhile boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and milk, and steam the beans.Stir the horseradish into the sour cream, carve the beef and serve with everything.The Pie CaseEvery prayer answered Yes sundaeBruce answers every prayer Yes. Every topping at once, under hot fudge.How to make it1 L vanilla ice cream150g dark chocolate, chopped150ml thickened cream2 tbsp golden syrup2 bananas, sliced250g strawberries, halved60g salted peanuts, chopped300ml whipped cream4 maraschino cherries2 tbsp rainbow sprinklesHeat the cream and golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir into a glossy fudge.Layer banana, strawberries and scoops of ice cream in 4 tall glasses.Pour over the hot fudge, then add the cream, peanuts, sprinkles and a cherry each.The FountainJuan Valdez iced coffeeBruce manifests himself some coffee. Colombian cold brew, condensed milk, ice.How to make it80g Colombian coffee, coarsely ground800ml cold water120ml sweetened condensed milk200ml milk2 cups ice cubesStir the coffee into the cold water and leave in the fridge for 12 hours, then strain.Spoon condensed milk into 4 glasses and fill with ice.Pour over the cold brew and top with milk, then stir.
